echo '== imports'; I=$(go list -e -overlay $P/overlay.json -f '{{join .Imports " "}}' ./session) || exit 1; for i in $I; do case $i in encoding/json|errors|fmt|strings|time|morphstudio/stream) ;; *) echo "imports: package session imports $i (allowed: encoding/json, errors, fmt, strings, time, morphstudio/stream)"; exit 1;; esac; done
